MOD = 51123987

def count_crossing_subpalindrome_pairs(text):
    n = len(text)
    count = 0
    
    # Manacher's algorithm to find all palindromic substrings
    P = [0] * n
    C = R = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        mirror = 2 * C - i
        if i < R:
            P[i] = min(R - i, P[mirror])
        
        # Attempt to expand palindrome centered at i
        while 0 <= i + P[i] + 1 < n and 0 <= i - P[i] - 1 < n and text[i + P[i] + 1] == text[i - P[i] - 1]:
            P[i] += 1
        
        # Update center and right boundary if needed
        if i + P[i] > R:
            C = i
            R = i + P[i]
    
    # Count the number of crossing subpalindromes
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if P[i] + i >= j:
                count = (count + 1) % MOD
    
    return count
